reason: The run took separate positive and negative BCE means and applied 1.0/0.1 weights. The released RaLD code applies one unweighted BCEWithLogitsLoss over concatenated queries, so the run erased the intended 6.25/93.75 sample-ratio normalization and biased occupancy toward all-positive predictions.
superseded_interpretation: A later line-level source audit showed that the all-query BCE interpretation came from RaLD evaluation code. Official RaLD training uses 0.1 times the occupied class-mean BCE plus 1.0 times the empty class-mean BCE.
disposition: Keep logs and checkpoints for audit only. Do not resume, select, compare, or cite them as G1D results. Use the G1D v2 source-parity and scale-corrected protocol recorded after the 8598871 invalid run.
